mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality, reducing equity risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and the FEDFUNDS rate is below 1.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that the central bank is not aggressively tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand, as measured by a 3-month average of HOUST above 550.0, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated business confidence and consumption growth.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 550.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a single month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to a reduction in equity risk premiums and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When both the GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential sales (RSAFS) are growing above their 3-month moving averages, it signals a robust economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where both GDPC1 and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 100,000 persons, it signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 100000.0, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and the FEDFUNDS rate is above 2.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity risk appetite, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
